findings.problem: The example uses words not met before this card: Dibuja, recta, papel. In the frequency phase it may use at most two words not met yet.

back.es: line (a drawn mark; also a phone, bus or metro line)
back.example: Draw a straight line on the paper.

note: Bare "line" most naturally gives línea, but a short hint such as "a drawn line, a phone line" would help rule out fila (a queue of people) and renglón (a line of text).
